name: firestore-composite-or-with-orderby-and-limit
description: or(...) composite filter combined with orderBy(...), limit(...), nested and(...), chained query(...), and top-level multi-filter validation in query(coll, ...).

wherePlusOrSameCall.message: InvalidQuery. When using composite filters, you cannot use more than one filter at the top level. Consider nesting the multiple filters within an `and(...)` statement. For example: change `query(query, where(...), or(...))` to `query(query, and(where(...), or(...)))`.
